## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Change is covered by tests when behavior changes (offline / `mock:echo` preferred)
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, and `mypy` pass locally (`make lint typecheck`)
- [ ] Docs / docstrings updated when public API changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or large generated artifacts committed
